---
applyTo: 'admin-dashboard/**'
---
this is a elderly wellness app, it is mostly a chat gpt wrapper so that retirement homes and elderly care facilities can use it to help their residents with day to day tasks and questions.

this is the admin facing dashboard, and admin as in myself or any other maintainers of the project, not the end users. the end users will be using a mobile app that is still in development.

when writing code, try to always use existing components if the exist in #components, existing styles if the exist in #styles, and follow the overall design patterns established in the project.

existing database services are in #services
